purpose: Carry graph-backed source and canonical module identity into in-memory ModuleInterface objects without changing interface text or import semantics.
question: How does a module interface identify the graph node and original source that own its exported API?
decision: Each ModuleInterface records snapshot-local moduleId, SourceFileId sourceId, existing display path, canonicalPath, and entry status. TypeChecker copies sourceId and canonicalPath from the matching Program::moduleGraph node when available, while retaining the ModuleStmt sourceId fallback for compatibility. The text emitter does not print the new identity fields in this slice.

identity_fields.source_id: Program-local SourceFileId for source metadata and diagnostics.
identity_fields.display_path: Existing ModuleInterface path retained for current text output and diagnostics-oriented inspection.
identity_fields.canonical_path: Resolved canonical path used by the import graph for duplicate-module identity.

production_path.source: Program::moduleGraph matched by moduleId, with ModuleStmt::sourceId fallback.
production_path.text_consumer: ModuleInterfaceEmitter preserves the existing output and ignores internal identity fields.
production_path.semantic_consumers: Current ModuleSymbols and dependency-body checking remain authoritative until later interface-consumer slices.

compatibility_boundary.imports: Direct imports, namespace imports, re-exports, search paths, and cycle behavior are unchanged.
compatibility_boundary.artifacts: IR, bytecode, cdbc text, Rust VM execution, and runtime diagnostics are unchanged.
compatibility_boundary.persistence: Identity fields are in-memory snapshot metadata and are not serialized or used as cache keys.

migration: Populate interface identity from the graph carried by Program, prove graph/interface correspondence on an import fixture, and keep the existing text emitter as the compatibility reference. Later M3A slices migrate exported symbol/type consumers; M3B owns separate compilation and cache behavior.
quantitative_gate: The ir_source_location CTest validates every emitted interface identity against its graph node, the module_interface_emitter CTest preserves existing text output, the m0d-2026-07-22-r1 inventory validates 1,745 cases, and canonical plus legacy parity commands report zero unexplained differences.
old_path_deletion_condition: Delete no production path in this slice. Remove the ModuleStmt-only identity fallback only after all module interfaces use graph identity and later interface consumers no longer depend on body-only module metadata. Keep the current text emitter until a separate serialized-interface decision.
out_of_scope: separate compilation and per-module cdbc artifacts
changes to interface text, diagnostics, IR, bytecode, or Rust VM behavior
